_comment: Synthetic replies in the shape of GitHub's GraphQL pullRequest connection, as scripts/security/cla_precheck.py queries it. Every login, name, id and head is invented except wshallwshall (cla.yml's public allowlist entry) and github-actions[bot]'s id 41898282, the id the vendored action drops. Each scenario is the list of pages GitHub would return, in order.
